create.name: Rabbi Shefa Gold
create.bio:
Rabbi Shefa Gold is a teacher, composer and leading voice in Hebrew chant as a spiritual practice. From Jemez Springs in northern New Mexico she runs C-DEEP, her centre for devotional and ecstatic practice, and she plays a leading part in ALEPH, the main Jewish Renewal network. She was ordained by the Reconstructionist Rabbinical College and by Rabbi Zalman Schachter-Shalomi, the founder of Jewish Renewal, and her teaching also draws on Buddhist, Christian, Sufi and Native American paths she has walked.

At the heart of her work is the chant: a single sacred phrase from Torah, the Psalms or the liturgy, sung over and over until it becomes a doorway into meditation, open-hearted prayer and a felt sense of the Divine. She has composed chants for every one of the 150 Psalms, released ten albums and created apps for daily practice. For many years she trained rabbis, cantors and lay leaders as chant leaders through her two-year Kol Zimra programme. Her books include The Magic of Hebrew Chant, Torah Journeys, In the Fever of Love on the Song of Songs, and Are We There Yet?, on travel as a spiritual path. She now leads weekly online chanting sessions, retreats and interfaith gatherings on the Psalms, and occasional pilgrimages abroad.

books.title: Are We There Yet? Travel as a Spiritual Path
books.author: Shefa Gold
books.description: Rabbi Shefa's reflections from decades of journeys, treating travel as a spiritual practice that wakes us up to wonder, challenge and the sacred in unfamiliar places.

courses.title: SOULIFT Retreat: Diving Deeper into the 8 Pathways of the Psalms
courses.description: A week-long residential retreat in Central Florida exploring eight ways of meeting life's challenges through the Psalms, from gratefulness and praise to lament and comfort, through chant, inquiry and celebration.

courses.title: Exploring the Magic and Medicine of the Psalms: A Common Heart Retreat
courses.description: An interfaith residential retreat at Holy Family Monastery in Hartford, Connecticut, led with Rev. Matthew Wright, using the Psalms shared by Jewish and Christian traditions as pathways of reflection and practice.

courses.title: KZoom: Weekly Online Chanting Session
courses.description: A weekly online gathering on Thursday evenings (US time) where Rabbi Shefa leads Hebrew chant and meditation on a theme. Details come by joining the KZoom mailing list.
